mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.customer_no, c.name, c.phone, c.email, COUNT(r.id) AS stay_count, c.created_at, c.updated_at FROM customers c LEFT JOIN reservations r ON r.customer_id = c.id WHERE c.id = #{id} GROUP BY c.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO customers(customer_no, name, phone, email) VALUES(#{customerNo}, #{name}, #{phone}, #{email})
mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.reservation_no, r.room_id, r.customer_id, rooms.room_number, rooms.room_name, rooms.cleaning_status AS room_cleaning_status, r.check_in_date, r.check_out_date, r.checked_in_at, r.checked_out_at, r.guest_name, r.guest_kana, r.guest_gender, r.guest_age, r.guest_phone, r.guest_email, r.guest_count, r.reservation_form, r.payment_status, r.reservation_status, r.total_amount, r.note, '' AS companion_summary, r.created_at, r.updated_at FROM reservations r JOIN rooms ON rooms.id = r.room_id WHERE r.customer_id = #{customerId} ORDER BY r.check_in_date DESC, r.id DESC
